reuse.why: Uses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, applyWeekendRule, dayFromDate and the captureBreadcrumb pattern already used by getUpcomingDates, but writes its own daily weekend-skip dispatch instead of sharing one.

duplication.why: The daily-skip versus move-the-weekend dispatch (skipWeekend && daily && isWeekend → skip, otherwise applyWeekendRule) is re-written next to the same dispatch in getUpcomingDates and getNextDate.

placement.why: The handler sits in server/schedules/app.ts beside getUpcomingDates and is registered with the other schedule methods.

scope.why: Adds only the handler, its registration, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Short and readable with a commented search margin, but a future change to weekend handling must be made in yet another copy of the dispatch.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts reshapes getUpcomingDates' skipDaily branch into an inline `skipWeekend && isDaily && isWeekend` continue plus `applyWeekendRule(date, skipWeekend && !isDaily, …)` rather than sharing it.
